title: AlgoExpert · Max Profit With K Transactions

slides.heading: Max Profit With K Transactions
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Very Hard · Dynamic Programming
slides.narration: Let's solve Max Profit With K Transactions, a very hard dynamic programming problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Daily prices, at most k buy/sell pairs (no overlap); max profit.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Daily prices, at most k buy or sell pairs (no overlap); max profit.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: For each transaction count, track the best profit by day using the best buy so far.
slides.narration: For each transaction count, track the best profit by day using the best buy so far.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Track best buy → O(k·n), two rows
slides.narration: The naive DP checks every buy day for every sell day. Tracking the best value of previous profit minus price makes each row linear.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. Rows for transactions, columns for days
2. Carry max of previous row minus price
3. Profit is max of skip or sell today
slides.narration: Step by step. First, rows for transactions, columns for days. Second, carry max of previous row minus price. Third, profit is max of skip or sell today. Fourth, two rows suffice.

slides.caption: Prices; k = 2
slides.narration: Prices five, eleven, three, fifty, sixty, ninety; at most two transactions.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: For each transaction count, we sweep days, updating best buy with prev profit minus price, and cur as the max of yesterday or selling today. Then swap rows.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n times k. Space is O of n.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: If k is at least half the days, it's the unlimited case.

slides.heading: Interview tips & follow-ups
slides.narration: Explain best buy as the max of prior profit minus price.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: For each transaction count, track the best profit by day using the best buy so far.
slides.narration: To recap Max Profit With K Transactions: For each transaction count, track the best profit by day using the best buy so far. Try re-implementing it from scratch without looking.
